tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jigs byed sa lugs kyi zur 'debs dang po'i las can dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs khros pa gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dkyil mchog rdul tshon brten pa'i phyogs yin la/ de las ras bris la brten pa'i gsal kha cung zad brjod na stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa ras la sogs pas bkab pa'i steng du 'bru cung zad bcal du bkram pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇ+ḍal dri bzangs kyi thig le byas par lha dgu'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i 'og tu sa lha'i tshom bu'ang bkod/ de dang nye bar sa lha'i sgos mchod dang gtor ma dang / de dag gi phyi rol du phyi mchod dang sgos mchod rgyas bsdus gang rigs/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang / slob ma sta gon gyi chas la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chab bran te/ oṃ ya ma ra dza sogs tsa sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhū was sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros smyon pa rdo rje 'jigs byed dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams dang bcas pa a rak+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ urman tra bhai ra a gh+ra ṭi ṭha ṭi ṭha zhes dang / swa swa ti a dhi pa te a gh+ra ṭi ṭha ṭi ṭha zhes brtan par bzhugs su gsol la de rnams kyi ljags kyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / 'jig rten pa'i gtor sngags gnyis ni oṃ urma ṣan+ḍa la bhai ra wa ya ba liṃ grih+na ma ma ka d+ya ba d+ya ya swā hā/ zhes dang dur khrod brgyad la/ aṣ+ṭa sa swa na tiṣ+ṭha bhu ta sa sa rak+ṣan ta satwa grih+na daṃ pa liṃ ma ma sarba ka d+ya ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas dbul lo/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang /

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /bka' skyong smyon pa 'jigs byed dang / /dur khrod bdag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas deng shig gi bar lha'i mtshan bsgyur ba ma gtogs gshed dmar dkyil chog tshig dang 'dra/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor ba dang dril bu drag tu bsil/ ya ma rā dza sogs drag tu brjod/ de nas gnas yo byin rlabs ya ma rā dzas bsangs la skyabs sems rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas shel sgong dag pa ltar gyur gyi bar gshed dmar ltar ro/ /rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs nas/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ma he'i gdong pa can du gyur/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs gzhung bsrangs/ sa lha'i tshom bu la dmigs te/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi zhes brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi sa phyogs de rdo rje sa gzhi/ rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ rang lhar gsal ba'i sogs nas bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin dang / spro na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhes sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar brjod de/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par gyur/ zhes dang / slar yang gong ltar mchod la/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg te/ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ /zhes brjod la mchod gtor dman ma bsdu/ lha sta gon ni/ tshom bu dgod/ sngags ya ma rā dza tshar dgu brjod/ de nas tshom bu ya ma rā dzas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ aṃ las rlung gis sogs nas bstod ba'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i skabs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams can kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ grub chen nā ro ta pa/ bha ro phyag rdum/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang / chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang bud+dha singha/ 'bum rab 'byams pa rgyal ba blo gros/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon lhun grub dpal ldan/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ aḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang skur rgyud bshad man ngag mnos sogs dang / ya ma rā dza sogs/ yi ge so gnyis pa'i mthar rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ aḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud sogs nas/ a mṛ ta swa da'i bar gshed dmar ltar ro/ /gtor ma ni skabs 'dir bstod pa'i rjes su phul te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te sogs kyi snyan gsan phab ste dkyil 'khor nam 'khor nam mkha' 'degs pa'am/ yang na skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor ma btegs par 'og bum bskyed kyi mjug tu gtor ma phul te/ de nas slob ma sta gon bya mjug tu dkyil 'khor 'degs pa sogs gang bde bya'o/ /bum pa'i skabs su bum pa gnyis char du rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed pa gzhung bzhin no/ /slob ma sta gon gyi skabs su sems bskyed gsal btab nas mgo rgyang gi bshad pa cung zad byed par spro na/ 'jigs byed dbang gis spyi bshad mdor bsdus kho bos logs su bris pa ltar/ de la skabs 'dir 'jig byed sa lugs yin tshul gyi brda sprod bya/

mtshams sbyor cung zad dgos pa rnams gshed dmar ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dkyil thang rab gnas can bkram pa'i mthar mchod gtor rnams gong sta gon gyi skabs bzhin dang / khyad par ting lo chang bu sogs sbyangs chas kyi gtor ma yungs kar til nag gu gul me long sku phyis rnams dang / slob ma la dgos pa'i dbang rdzas sogs ma tshang ba med par bshams/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor la sbyangs khrus rnams bde mchog bzhin la sngags rnams hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥṣ+ṭi 'ba' zhig rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la zhes pa tshig phrad bsgyur ba tsam dang / de nas dkyil 'khor swa bha was sbyangs nas lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas bstod pa'i bar dkyil chog bzhin/ de nas phyi rol gtor ma ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas sgrib pa'am yang na phyi rol du bya ste/ mchod gtor bsham tshul gshed dmar dang cig gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin rlabs/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang 'dra/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs dang / yig brgya dang / ma 'byor ba sogs hrīḥbi shud+dhes bshal chu sbyin/ badz+ramuḥgator mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ rang dang slob ma'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung / nang du 'ong ba sogs dkyil chog bzhin/ de nas dngos gzhi mang po byed na rjes ma rnams la skabs 'dir bum bskyed tshul bzhin byas/ bdag 'jug len de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ 'das gtor dkyil 'khor la 'bul bas gtor mgron sbyin mi dgos/ badz+ra bhe ra wa a gra sogs brtan bzhugs dang / rtsa sngags kyi rjes su o bhai ra wa grih+na daṃ ba liṃ swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi mchod/

'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ gzugs sgra sogs kyis yid mchod/ dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs kyi bstod/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar kun 'grub shog gi bar ro/ /gong lha sta gon gyi skabs su gtor ma 'bul tshul yang 'di ltar ro/ /de nas gzhan la dbang bskur tshul mtshams sbyor cung zad dgos pa rnams gshed dmar ltar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang las dang po pa la phan pha'i ched du/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod du bya bral ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'i legs byas kyi dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi zur 'debs dang po'i las can dga' byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
